threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts staff endpoints and cloud tenant workloads (file server, reporting database, integration server)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Signature antivirus only (no endpoint detection and response); no security monitoring; backups in the production account
existing_controls: MFA for all staff; signature antivirus; annual awareness training
treatment_plan: Managed endpoint detection and response with 24x7 alerting; quarterly phishing exercises; immutable backups (R-019)

threat_event: Exfiltration of student financial aid and education records during a ransomware attack (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unencrypted financial aid exports on the file server readable by all financial aid and business office staff; no egress monitoring
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 file server; SYS-07; SYS-03 exports
existing_controls: Firewall blocks inbound traffic; MFA on staff accounts
treatment_plan: Remove standing exports from the file server; encrypt required exports; outbound transfer alerting at the firewall and in the cloud tenant

threat_event: Unencrypted financial aid spreadsheet with ISIR data and SSNs is emailed to the wrong recipient or lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports are routine; no encryption; no data loss prevention rule
existing_controls: Internal email stays within the tenant
treatment_plan: Replace spreadsheet handoffs with a restricted FAMS report role for the business office; enforce message encryption for external email containing SSNs; data loss prevention rule for SSN patterns

threat_event: Takeover of a financial aid servicer administrator account on the student-facing financial aid portal exposes tax and verification documents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servicer administrators use local FAMS accounts with passwords only; internet-facing sign-in
existing_controls: Servicer contract requires reasonable safeguards
treatment_plan: Contract amendment requiring MFA for all servicer accounts within 30 days, or federation through the college identity provider; quarterly servicer account review

threat_event: Student portal account takeover redirects a Title IV credit balance refund to an attacker's bank account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA optional for students; bank detail changes take effect without out-of-band confirmation
existing_controls: Refunds paid only by direct deposit; business office reviews returned payments
treatment_plan: Require student MFA before any change to refund or bank details; 3-day hold and email and text confirmation on bank changes

threat_event: Attacker or student uses the shared lab administrator password to install malware and move from the lab VLAN toward staff systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One local admin password on all 150 lab PCs, known to IT students; lab-to-staff firewall rules not reviewed since 2023
existing_controls: Separate lab VLAN; lab PCs re-imaged each term
treatment_plan: Unique managed local admin passwords; separate isolated practice lab for admin exercises; review and tighten lab-to-staff firewall rules

threat_event: Former adjunct faculty member accesses courses and student grades after the contract ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adjuncts use local LMS accounts outside the identity provider; no termination step for LMS
existing_controls: HR notifies IT of staff terminations
treatment_plan: Move adjuncts to identity provider accounts; disable the 11 stale accounts now; monthly LMS account reconciliation

threat_event: Staff view student education and financial aid records without a legitimate educational interest
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Admissions and advisor SIS roles show every student's full record and aid holds; no access review
existing_controls: Role-based SIS access by department
treatment_plan: Redesign SIS roles (admissions sees applicants only; advisors see assigned students); semiannual access review by data owners

threat_event: Security failure at the SIS, LMS, or FAMS vendor or the servicer goes unnoticed until students are harmed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor oversight is limited to contract terms; SOC 2 reports never reviewed
existing_controls: Contracts with security and FERPA school-official clauses
treatment_plan: Annual vendor review: SOC 2 Type 2 report, bridge letter, and complementary user entity controls (P09); servicer security questionnaire

threat_event: SIS vendor outage during registration or a disbursement week
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; no downtime procedure
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments in contract
treatment_plan: Downtime procedures (printed rosters, manual add/drop log); confirm vendor recovery commitments against the BIA (P05)

threat_event: Intrusion into the SIS or FAMS through a valid account goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of SIS or FAMS user activity logs; no alerting
existing_controls: Vendors keep audit logs
treatment_plan: Weekly identity provider sign-in review; monthly SIS and FAMS bulk-export and privileged-change review

threat_event: Unpatched firewall or remote-access VPN exploited from the internet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No penetration test; ad hoc vulnerability scans (last in 2025); firmware updated irregularly
existing_controls: MFA on the VPN; no inbound services except VPN
treatment_plan: Vulnerability scans at least every six months and after material changes; annual external penetration test; quarterly firmware updates

threat_event: College misses the FTC, FSA, or Florida notification deadline after a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Incident response plan is a contact list with no notification steps or decision owners
existing_controls: Contact list
treatment_plan: Written incident response plan addressing 314.4(h)(1)-(7) (POL-03) and the P08 runbook with the notification matrix; annual tabletop

threat_event: Title IV compliance audit reports a GLBA finding and FSA questions administrative capability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Risk assessment 2 years old; no written report to the Board; missing Safeguards Rule elements
existing_controls: Written information security program (2023); Qualified Individual designated
treatment_plan: Complete this 2026 risk assessment; first written report to the Board on 2026-10-15; close P03 gaps by target dates

threat_event: Business email compromise of a financial aid or business office mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff targeted by aid-themed phishing; training once a year
existing_controls: MFA on email; external sender banner
treatment_plan: Quarterly phishing exercises; verify payment and bank changes by phone

threat_event: Customer information kept long after it is needed enlarges the impact of any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention and disposal schedule; aid records kept indefinitely
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Retention schedule aligned to Title IV record retention (FSA Handbook Vol. 2 Ch. 7) and 314.4(c)(6); annual disposal run

threat_event: Untested SIS or integration change corrupts enrollment or aid eligibility data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change management procedure; changes made directly in production
existing_controls: Vendor release notes reviewed informally
treatment_plan: Change request, test, and approval steps for SIS, FAMS, and integration changes; change log

threat_event: Hurricane closes the campus for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; lab-based instruction cannot move online
existing_controls: Core systems are SaaS; staff laptops allow remote work
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with remote operations and make-up lab schedule

threat_event: Backups are deleted or encrypted along with production so the file server and reporting database cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same account and region; same administrators; never restore-tested
existing_controls: Daily backups
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Early-alert model scores some student groups as higher risk for reasons unrelated to their need, leading to unequal interventions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No fairness testing; historical outcome data reflects past inequities; no written human review rule
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 analytics module; SYS-08 reporting database
regulatory_driver: N61-R01 (99.31(a)(1)(i)(B)); federal civil rights laws (see P10)
existing_controls: Pilot limited to 2 programs; advisors see scores
treatment_plan: Pre-expansion fairness testing, student notice, and human review before any intervention (see P10)

threat_event: Admissions scoring deprioritizes applicants from some groups for outreach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CRM applicant scoring feature available but not assessed
existing_controls: Feature not enabled
treatment_plan: Keep the feature disabled until a P10 assessment approves it; configuration check each release

threat_event: FAFSA data or federal tax information is used for purposes the HEA does not allow (for example, in the reporting database or model inputs)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ISIR fields copied nightly into the reporting database with other SIS data
regulatory_driver: N61-R02 (314.4(c)(1)(ii)); HEA sec. 483 (FSA Handbook Vol. 2 Ch. 7)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Stop copying ISIR fields to the reporting database; tag FAFSA and FTI fields and restrict to financial aid roles

threat_event: Malware on a SAIG transmission workstation captures ISIR data or Department system credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staff also use the 2 dedicated workstations for web browsing and email
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; antivirus
treatment_plan: Restrict the 2 workstations to SAIG and Department sites; no email on them

threat_event: Staff credential theft through MFA fatigue or session token theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push-approval MFA without number matching
existing_controls: MFA for all staff
treatment_plan: Enable number matching; phishing-resistant keys for IT and financial aid administrators

threat_event: Student immunization and background check documents collected through LMS assignments are exposed to other course users
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Program directors collect clinical placement documents as LMS assignments
existing_controls: Assignments are visible to instructors only by default
treatment_plan: Move clinical placement documents to a restricted SIS document type; purge from LMS

threat_event: Theft of paper financial aid files from the records room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records room lock shared by 9 key holders; no key log
existing_controls: Building alarm after hours
treatment_plan: Rekey; badge reader; scan and dispose of paper files per the retention schedule

threat_event: Campus internet outage stops on-campus classes and staff access to SaaS systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single internet provider
existing_controls: Staff can work remotely
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Campus President: residual risk Low; revisit when the contract renews in 2027

threat_event: Denial of service against the LMS during final exams
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside college control
existing_controls: Vendor DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low; exam windows can be extended

threat_event: Lost or stolen staff laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops leave campus daily
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all staff endpoints; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted: encryption reduces impact; residual risk Low

threat_event: Financial aid staff member creates a fraudulent award or disbursement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Few people; manual overrides in FAMS
existing_controls: Separation of duties between financial aid and business office
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of manual award overrides by the Business Office Manager

threat_event: IT staff miss new threats because they receive no security-specific training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three-person IT team; no security training budget
existing_controls: Annual general awareness training
treatment_plan: Annual security training for IT staff; subscribe to CISA and FSA cybersecurity alerts

threat_event: Integration server service account with broad SIS and FAMS API rights is stolen and used to extract data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One service account with read-write access to all SIS and FAMS objects; secret stored in a config file
existing_controls: Integration server reachable only from the cloud tenant
treatment_plan: Scope API rights to the fields synced; move the secret to the cloud key management service; rotate quarterly

threat_event: Fraudulent applicants enroll in online programs to obtain Title IV funds using stolen identities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Online admissions rely on uploaded documents; no identity verification step
existing_controls: Admissions representatives interview applicants by phone
treatment_plan: Identity verification for online applicants before aid packaging; red-flag review of shared addresses, phones, and devices
